Memory and Knowledge Systems 06. Advanced Memory and Knowledge AI 06.01 Memory Augmented Networks Memory-Augmented Networks (MANs) are neural architectures that extend conventional learning systems with an explicit memory mechanism for storing, accessing, and updating information. Unlike traditional neural networks, which primarily encode learned knowledge in model parameters, these architectures maintain additional memory representations that can be accessed during inference.

Memory and Knowledge Systems 05. Hybrid LLM Systems 05.00 Overview Hybrid Large Language Model (LLM) systems represent an architectural approach that combines the generative and reasoning capabilities of language models with external knowledge, retrieval mechanisms, persistent memory, and executable tools. Rather than relying exclusively on knowledge encoded during pretraining, these systems dynamically access information and computational resources to produce responses that are more relevant, adaptable, and grounded in operational contexts.

Memory and Knowledge Systems 04. Knowledge Integration 04.00 Overview Knowledge integration is a fundamental capability of intelligent systems that must combine information from heterogeneous sources into a coherent and usable representation. Modern artificial intelligence increasingly depends on more than isolated datasets or pretrained model parameters. Effective knowledge integration connects structured facts, unstructured documents, learned representations, and contextual observations to support consistent understanding, reasoning, and decision-making.

articles.title: hidepid turns process visibility into a service isolation decision
articles.excerpt: hidepid turns process visibility into a service isolation decision The /proc filesystem can reveal command lines, process ownership, resource use, and the names of programs running under other account…
articles.body: hidepid turns process visibility into a service isolation decision The /proc filesystem can reveal command lines, process ownership, resource use, and the names of programs running under other accounts. Linux provides the hidepid= mount option to restrict that visibility [1]. It is a useful local-information control, but its effect depends on the procfs instance, the process namespace, the authorized group, and the workloads that need to inspect one another. What each mode changes The kernel documentation defines hidepid=off or hidepid=0 as the classic mode in which users may access every /proc/<pid>/ directory. hidepid=noaccess or hidepid=1 prevents users from accessing another user's process directories while leaving enough information to learn that a process may exist.
articles.author: facilishz

Memory and Knowledge Systems 03. Long Term Memory 03.00 Overview Long-term memory is a fundamental capability of intelligent systems that must preserve information beyond a single interaction, computation, or operational session. Unlike temporary context maintained during immediate processing, long-term memory enables artificial intelligence to retain experiences, acquired knowledge, learned preferences, and operational procedures. This capability supports continuity, adaptation, and increasingly informed decision-making across extended periods.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.

articles.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
articles.excerpt: By modeling how a planet without life develops its atmosphere, astronomers hope to be able to better distinguish rocky planets without life from those that are inhabited.
articles.body: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe. Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life.

articles.excerpt: If you follow the EV industry in North America, you’d be forgiven for thinking that the future of transportation revolves around electric SUVs and pickups. Every week seems to bring another teaser fro…
articles.body: If you follow the EV industry in North America, you’d be forgiven for thinking that the future of transportation revolves around electric SUVs and pickups. Every week seems to bring another teaser from a startup promising to reinvent the family car or truck. The latest electric SUVs, “coming soon” tiny trucks, lifestyle trucks, modular trucks, etc. Companies like Slate, TELO, and countless others have generated plenty of excitement, even if many of them still have everything left to prove. Don’t get me wrong – I hope they succeed. We need more affordable electric vehicles.
